current.description: On a conflict, the item as stored

ends_at.description: Absent for a license without an end, such as a renewing subscription or a lifetime purchase

source.description: Extensible enum: subscription, order, manual, legacy

discount_percent.description: The regional discount checkout applies without a discount code, 0 for none

max_seats.description: The most seats a checkout sells, from the plan's Polar seat tiers; 1 unless per_seat, null when the tiers set no maximum

min_seats.description: The fewest seats a checkout sells; 1 unless per_seat

An invitation is sent at most once every 10 minutes. It keeps its seat as it is: an expired one still holds its reservation, and one whose reservation was taken back stays without a seat, so accepting it needs a free seat at that moment. Creating and resending together: 50 an hour per caller and team, and 100 an hour per team, whoever sends them; one that fails is not counted against the team.
